title: Inverse images along immersions preserve pro-etale limits
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $u:Y\to X$ be a locally closed immersion (a composite of an open and a closed immersion), as in [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the inverse-image functor $u^{-1}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] preserves all small limits of sheaves of sets and of abelian sheaves. For every ring sheaf $R$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, module inverse image to $u^{-1}R$ is exact and preserves all small limits of sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Limits use the same fixed universe as the sites. No Noetherian assumption on either scheme is imposed.
